_note: Agent curation for the DEE community layer. Every quote must string-match (after NFKC/dash/quote/whitespace normalisation) the stored page data/raw/families/dee/community/web/<src>.txt, or the unescaped .html when in=html (logo alt text / link targets). build_community.py drops anything that does not match; verify_community.py re-checks the output.
